description: This Java source file, BomBuilder.java, defines a class responsible for building Bill of Materials (BOM) reports from PCB and component data, including reading input files, processing component lists, filtering, and writing output reports.

classes.name: BomBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for generating BOM reports from component and PCB data files, with configurable options for report detail and filtering.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution method, parses arguments, loads data files, and triggers BOM report generation.

methods.name: writeMissingElements
methods.description: Writes missing BOM entries or unmounted components into report.

methods.name: writeFullPartList
methods.description: Generates a detailed comprehensive part list CSV file.

methods.name: writeCompactPartList
methods.description: Generates a summarized compact part list CSV file.

methods.name: writeCommonHeader
methods.description: Writes header information to CSV output files.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes individual component entries into the output CSV based on BOM data.

methods.name: readBomDictionary
methods.description: Parses BOM dictionary CSV content into a map of BOM records.
